column1: # inf_exclude.tsv -- expression shapes the infinite_snobol4 generators never emit (Lon 2026-10-02: "We must avoid somehow the
# hanging ones. Make an exclusion list?"). An entry is a substring; the Icon section of infinite_snobol4.md, inf_exclusions(), carries the same list.

column2: SUCCEED and &SUCCEED match again on every backtrack, so a match whose later element fails never ends, in SPITBOL as in SCRIP (the language, not a defect)
column3: sbl -bf hung on EVAL of 'a' ? SUCCEED +&CODE TAB(2), 2026-10-02 (ceo)

column2: a power of 0 or 1 to &STLIMIT (2147483647) runs in SPITBOL by repeated multiplication for minutes; SCRIP answers at once, so the language is not at issue, the oracle's patience is
column3: sbl -bf gave no answer in 5 s to 0 ! &STLIMIT, 1 ** &STLIMIT, 1 ! &STLIMIT, 0.0 ** &STLIMIT, 0.0 ^ &STLIMIT, 0.0 ! &STLIMIT (the exhaustive set at 3 tokens, 2026-10-02, ceo)

column2: as above, the ^ spelling of the power

a keyword naming the place in the EVALUATING program: the SCRIPtix program and its SPITBOL child are two programs, so their answers can never agree; the offline comparison (one program under both engines) agrees on it under --stlimit
column3: all thirty keywords agree under scrip --stlimit in one program, 2026-10-02 (ceo); the COMM channel's 150 differing replies of 19,251 were these seven keywords and nothing else
